task_definition.task_description:
Please check whether the black Sony WH-1000XM5 is in stock, then look up similar audio alternatives for me and choose one option to buy. After that, reserve 1 of the silver Sony WH-1000XM5, confirm the order, and then generate an invoice for 1 black Sony WH-1000XM5 to buyer@example.com with PayPal and the best available discount.

Then check my investment account status, get the current BTC price, check the AAPL quote, and use that quote to sell 2 shares of AAPL. Finally, scan for smart devices in the living room and turn on the living room light.

user_input.query: Please help me with a few things for user_01. First, in the audio category, check whether the black Sony WH-1000XM5 is in stock for product_id p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity 1, and note that my items are [{product_id: p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity: 1}]. Then find similar audio alternatives and pick one option for me to buy. After that, reserve 1 of the silver Sony WH-1000XM5 and confirm the order. Also, generate an invoice for 1 black Sony WH-1000XM5 for buyer@example.com using paypal, payment_method card, and apply the best available discount. Then check my investment account status, get the current BTC price for crypto_symbol BTC, check the AAPL quote for ticker AAPL, and use that quote to sell_quantity 2 shares. Finally, scan for smart devices in location living_room and turn device_id light_living to device_state on.
